skill.name: research-lookup
skill.description: Look up current research information with Perplexity Sonar models through OpenRouter. The skill selects a fast search model or a reasoning model based on query complexity, then returns cited research summaries.
skill.summary: Research current academic and technical sources with cited OpenRouter-powered lookups.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most high static detections are false positives from placeholder OPENROUTER_API_KEY references, setup instructions, and markdown code spans. Real residual risks are intended OpenRouter network calls, process environment access for an API key, broad tool permissions, and guidance to run an unbundled schematic command.

remediation.suggestion: Limit allowed tools to the minimum needed for lookup workflows, or document exactly why Write, Edit, and Bash are required.

remediation.issue: Default schematic generation references an external skill and missing local script
remediation.suggestion: Remove the default schematic-generation instruction or make it optional and clearly require user confirmation before running external tooling.

remediation.issue: Queries and metadata are sent to OpenRouter
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy note that research queries, prompts, and request metadata are sent to OpenRouter and Perplexity-backed models.

remediation.issue: API key handling depends on environment variables
remediation.suggestion: Continue avoiding secret logging and document that users should scope and rotate OpenRouter keys according to their account policy.

content.value_statement: Researchers need current sources that are hard to gather by hand. This skill searches OpenRouter-powered Perplexity models and returns cited summaries.
actual_capabilities: Selects Sonar Pro Search or Sonar Reasoning Pro based on query complexity.
Sends academic search requests to OpenRouter with high search context.
Returns research summaries with timestamps, model names, and token usage.
Extracts citations from API search results, DOI patterns, and scholarly URLs.
Supports single queries, batch queries, model information checks, and forced model selection.
limitations: Requires an OpenRouter API key and account credits.
Sends user queries and prompts to OpenRouter for processing.
May miss papers behind paywalls or sources not indexed by the provider.
Citations and summaries still need primary-source verification.

use_cases.title: Build a Literature Review
use_cases.description: Find recent papers, compare themes, and collect citations for a draft literature review.

use_cases.title: Verify Technical Claims
use_cases.description: Check claims, statistics, and methods against recent academic or institutional sources.

use_cases.title: Explore Research Directions
use_cases.description: Identify open questions, controversies, and useful follow-up searches in a research area.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Papers
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for current work on one topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research recent peer-reviewed papers on [topic] from 2023 to 2026. Summarize key findings and include citations.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Claim
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate a fact before using it in writing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this claim with recent academic or institutional sources: [claim]. Explain the evidence quality and cite sources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Approaches
prompt_templates.scenario: Use reasoning mode for a balanced technical comparison.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [approach A] and [approach B] for [use case]. Cover evidence, limitations, costs, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a research brief on [topic]. Include current consensus, contested findings, methods used, gaps, and high-quality citations.

output_examples.input: Research recent advances in CRISPR off-target detection.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of recent detection methods, key studies, reported limitations, and citation links for follow-up reading.

output_examples.input: Compare transformer models and recurrent neural networks for sequence modeling.
output_examples.output: A structured comparison covering performance, data needs, compute cost, interpretability, and relevant supporting papers.

output_examples.input: Find current statistics on renewable energy adoption.
output_examples.output: A dated summary of current statistics, source organizations, methodology notes, and cautions about regional comparability.

best_practices: Use specific topics, dates, populations, and source types in each query.
Verify important citations against primary sources before publication.
Use forced model selection only when speed or deeper reasoning is clearly needed.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential or regulated data in research queries.
Do not cite the generated summary as the original source.
Do not use broad prompts like research AI without scope, dates, or source expectations.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment and an OpenRouter account with available credits.

faq.question: Which models does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Perplexity Sonar Pro Search for faster lookups and Sonar Reasoning Pro for more complex analysis.

faq.question: Can it produce citations?
faq.answer: Yes. It extracts provider citations, DOI links, and scholarly source URLs when available.

faq.question: Is it safe for private research data?
faq.answer: Use caution. Queries are sent to OpenRouter, so avoid confidential, regulated, or proprietary information.

faq.question: Can it run batch searches?
faq.answer: Yes. The command line tool supports multiple queries with a delay between requests.

faq.question: Should I verify the results?
faq.answer: Yes. Treat the output as research assistance and verify important claims against primary sources.
